author: sonnet
label: c2-seed-sonnet-01
changes: Rewrote the file from a fragment list into the required layout: summary, terms, diagram, numbered steps, rules, failure table, open questions.
Made the ack happen only after the Message Store commit, and said the seq is assigned there per conversation.
Defined the outbox, relay and bus: outbox row in the same transaction, relay marks rows published after bus confirms, bus partitioned by conversation.
Spelled out the worker's per-recipient steps, the 5 s timer (who starts it and what counts as delivered), and that the event is committed only after all recipients are handled.
Defined presence: gateway id per user, 30 s TTL, refreshed by 10 s heartbeats, and said that re-creating an expired entry triggers a sync.
Defined inbox rules: entries only for offline or timed-out recipients, removed on client ack or at 30 days; expired messages stay in history.
Defined reconnect: client sends last seq per conversation, inbox says which conversations, Message Store supplies messages in seq order.

Restored brief facts that the first version lacked: 200 member limit, sender excluded, one device per user, push never retried and never affects storage, error on failed write with retry on same msg_id, out-of-scope list.
Added open questions for the live-versus-sync overlap, the inbox store choice and a slow gateway holding up a partition.
Event Bus term: stated the event holds ids only; Fan-out Worker now reads message and members from the Message Store (Q10).
Message Store term: now says it holds conversation membership; added that assumption to the open questions.
Gateway term and step 4: the worker calls the gateway internally and the gateway returns the client's ack as the reply (Q9).
Step 4 and diagram: recipients are handled in parallel; later events in the conversation wait (Q14).
Step 3 and diagram: relay publishes in seq order and restarts from the oldest unpublished row (Q12).
New step 5 and diagram line 5b: any client ack deletes the matching Inbox entry, so a late ack removes it (Q11).
Step 7 and diagram: presence is registered before the Inbox is read; entries at or below the client's last seq are deleted unsent; sender sync explained (Q11, Q13, Q15).
Steps after the new step 5 were renumbered; failure table cross-references updated.
Open questions: replaced the slow-gateway item with the concrete consequence of the 5 s wait; added the membership-source assumption.

Sync no longer uses the client's last seq: the Offline Inbox alone drives it, and the client dedupes by msg_id. This fixes a real bug where an Inbox entry (seq 6) was deleted unsent because a later live message (seq 7) had advanced the client's last seq, and it also answers how a heartbeat-triggered sync works with no client input.
Removed 'entries with seq <= client's last are deleted unsent' from the diagram and step 7, and said the Inbox is the complete list of what sync must send (Terms).
Step 4, diagram and failure table: a gateway reply 'user not connected' (stale Presence entry), or a failed call, is treated as offline at once, with no 5 s wait.
Merged the old step 4 sub-bullets (online/offline cases) into one paragraph and removed the repeated gateway-call details that the diagram already shows.
Dropped the separate 'Notes follow' line; added a one-line pointer saying the steps add only triggers, data ownership and failure handling beyond the diagram.
Moved Terms and the summary before the diagram and kept the diagram unchanged in form; steps now come after it as notes.
Shortened the summary to the main flow and why; kept the statement of how things work today.
Removed the Gateway's 'internal delivery call' cross-reference to step 4 in Terms; removed duplicated 'a message arrives on the next sync' wording.
Clarified in step 4 that delivered means the client ack for this msg_id, and that a stale presence entry means the gateway replies at once; kept the Q18 answer.

Kept every fixed requirement: 10 s heartbeat, 30 s TTL, 5 s timeout, 30-day expiry, 200 members, one device, sender excluded, ack after commit, retry by msg_id, best-effort unretried push, seq order on reconnect, at-least-once with client dedupe, out-of-scope list.
Kept sync running from the Inbox alone (no client last seq), as decided in rounds 3; did not add the cut details such as exact formats or library choices.
Open questions unchanged.
